summary: Completed comprehensive testing of 12-month subscription system implementation. All key features working correctly: paid plans have 12-month validity, no monthly quota reset (total quota for subscription period), quota exhaustion blocking, frontend quota badge shows plan expiry and remaining quota, plans modal displays '/12 ay' pricing and '12 ay için X fatura' quota descriptions. One minor backend test issue resolved (file type validation).

minor_issues.issue: RESOLVED - File type validation requires specific MIME types (text/html, application/pdf, image/jpeg, etc.)
minor_issues.impact: Test files with unsupported MIME types are rejected
minor_issues.fix_applied: Updated test to use text/html MIME type which is supported

design_issues.issue: Frontend correctly blocks direct access (shows 'Erişim Engellendi' message)
design_issues.explanation: This is INTENDED BEHAVIOR - app designed to only work when embedded in Wix site at documander.com. Localhost bypass works for development.
design_issues.fix_priority: NOT A BUG - Security feature working as designed

passed_tests: Trial Plan Creation - New users get trial plan with 7 days expiry and 20 file limit
Paid Plan 12 Month Expiry - Starter plan gets ~365 days (12 months) expiry
Professional Plan 12 Month Expiry - Professional plan gets ~365 days expiry
No Monthly Reset Logic - API uses total_uploads and total_limit fields for subscription period
Quota Exhaustion Blocking - Uploads correctly blocked when quota exhausted with proper error messages
Subscription Status Fields - All required fields present (plan, expires_at, is_annual_plan, etc.)
Plans API 12 Month Info - Plans show correct limits (1000, 2500) and prices (699, 1399) for 12-month system
Frontend Quota Badge - Shows plan type, expiry date, and remaining quota correctly
Frontend Plans Modal - Displays '/12 ay' pricing format for all paid plans
Frontend Quota Descriptions - Shows '12 ay için X fatura' format for quota descriptions
Frontend Access Control - Correctly blocks direct access, allows localhost for development
Upload Functionality - File upload with quota decrement working correctly
Session Management - Taxpayer session creation required before uploads

success_percentage.backend: 100% (6/6 twelve-month subscription tests passed after file type fix)
success_percentage.frontend: 95% (All 12-month features working, minor script error in detailed plan text extraction)
